name: Flashcube
author: Arial-Bold
description_short: A photo album for the GameCube in the spirit of the Wii Photo Channel, with slideshows, phone transfer and Melee snapshot import
description_long: Flashcube shows your SD card photos as an album with year, folder and favorite tabs, a zooming photo viewer and slideshows with MIDI music. Photos can be sent from a phone or computer over the network adapter, and Super Smash Bros. Melee snapshots can be copied from a memory card as PNG pictures. Playtime adds a photo puzzle, doodles and color looks. The menu is a glass cube you turn with the Control Stick.
